targets.query: SELECT anyLast(value) FROM ai_trader_dash_metrics WHERE date=today() AND session='learn' AND name='oos_sharpe'
SELECT anyLast(value) FROM ai_trader_dash_metrics WHERE date=today() AND session='learn' AND name='dq_failed_count'
SELECT ts, value FROM ai_trader_dash_metrics WHERE name='oos_sharpe' AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts, symbol, JSON_VALUE(payload,'$.action') AS action, JSON_VALUE(payload,'$.reason') AS reason, JSON_VALUE(payload,'$.dd_pct') AS dd_pct FROM ai_trader_events WHERE kind='guardian' AND ts>now()-INTERVAL 2 DAY ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT ts, JSON_VALUE(payload,'$.event') AS event, JSON_VALUE(payload,'$.reason') AS reason FROM ai_trader_events WHERE kind='tool' AND ts>now()-INTERVAL 2 DAY ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT ts, symbol, JSON_VALUE(payload,'$.hedge_symbol') AS hedge_sym, toFloat64OrZero(JSON_VALUE(payload,'$.hedge_qty'))*toFloat64OrZero(JSON_VALUE(payload,'$.ref_px')) AS notional FROM ai_trader_events WHERE kind='hedging' AND date=today() ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT ts, JSON_VALUE(payload,'$.kind') AS kind, JSON_VALUE(payload,'$.session') AS session, JSON_VALUE(payload,'$.action') AS action, left(JSON_VALUE(payload,'$.output'), 200) AS output_snip FROM ai_trader_events WHERE kind='brain' AND ts>now()-INTERVAL 2 DAY ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200
